article.title: Ports of resistance: Dockworkers across the world prepare October 30 strike against imperialist wars
article.author: Editor
article.content: The second International Day of Action of Dockworkers is expected to involve around 100 ports worldwide, as workers refuse to allow ports and transport infrastructure to become vital links in the machinery of imperialist war. The post Ports of resistance: Dockworkers across the world prepare October 30 strike against imperialist wars appeared first on MR Online .
